atoms.b: With right-angled triangles, there are ((++three two)) main ratios that you have to keep in mind.
If you divide the opposite side by the hypotenuse, you get the ((++sine cosine)) ratio.
You get the cosine ratio by dividing the ((hypotenuse ++adjacent_side)) by the ((++hypotenuse opposite_side)).
The remaining ratio is called the ((++tangent tannus)) ratio. To calculate this, divide the opposite side by the ((++adjacent_side hypotenuse)).
One way to remember the 3 ratios is with the mnemonic  ((++SOHCAHTOA SHOTOHCOA)).
atoms.sound: One way to remember the 3 ratios is with the mnemonic 'sockatoa'.

instruction.text: Use the diagram to complete the ratios correctly.

atoms.sound: sine theta equals opposite over hypotenuse
cos theta equals adjacent over hypotenuse
tan theta equals opposite over adjacent
